input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: Section 12.3 delivers the preferred position outright: Customer is expressly free to develop, acquire, licence, sell or use any product or service and to conduct business in any field or territory, and Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no non-compete commitment. A full-document search found no clause binding Customer not to develop, market or sell competing products and no field-of-use or territory limit on Customer. Section 2.2 ("sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services") is a sourcing/exclusivity commitment and Section 12.4 is a non-solicit; both are handled under the EXCLUSIVITY and no-hire rules respectively and are not double-flagged here. Section 13.4's usage restrictions (reverse engineering, interference, unlawful use) are ordinary licence-scope terms, not a non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer's business.
